title: Delhi's vehicle ban faces big test at borders: Can enforcement keep up?
content: Delhi is set to implement restrictions on older vehicles that fail to meet BS6 emission standards from entering the city. However, officials are grappling with the difficulty of monitoring numerous entry points, especially during rush hours. Leveraging technology, such as automatic number plate recognition, will be essential for identifying non-compliant vehicles. Collaboration between Delhi and neighboring NCR states is vital to prevent alternative routes and ensure effective enforcement.

title: Serena Williams helped build two Kenyan schools that remain open years later
content: Serena Williams established two secondary schools in rural Kenya to provide local children with education. The Matooni Serena Williams Secondary School opened in 2009, followed by the Wee Serena Williams Secondary School in 2010. Both schools are now integrated into Kenya's national education system and managed by community boards. HP's involvement brought important technology resources to enhance learning experiences for students.

title: Dutch engineer builds goldfish-driven car, sets Guinness record

By translating Blub's natural movements into steering commands, De Wolf envisions applications of this technology to assist people with physical disabilities, merging creativity with functionality.

title: Government has an important reminder for everyone coming to India from abroad

Indian passport holders, OCI cardholders, and foreign nationals must complete this form before arrival. This online form is part of COVID-19 screening measures and includes health status and travel details. Travelers should prepare necessary documents like their passport and visa to fill in the form.

After legal action and police involvement, the commission mandated the financial institutions to amend his credit history and awarded him compensation for mental distress and legal fees.

title: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio estate faces new security concerns

The village's architectural review board has delayed its decision and plans to revisit the revised proposal on November 10.

title: 'We will navigate through challenges': IndiGo CEO on airline industry's tough phase

The airline reported a net loss of Rs 1,879.1 crore due to elevated expenses and rupee depreciation. Walsh anticipates deliveries of wide-body Airbus A350 aircraft beginning in the second quarter of 2028. IndiGo plans to shift some international flights to the new Navi Mumbai airport to capitalize on upcoming opportunities.

title: US explores route to bring Russian gas back to Europe through Ukraine: Report

The proposal could offer Moscow a financial incentive while providing Kyiv with transit revenue, but faces strong European opposition amid concerns over renewed dependence on Russia.

The crime unfolded when their son, Gagandeep Singh, went to fetch milk, only to return and discover his mother lying in a pool of blood. Authorities have arrested Ravinder, suspecting infidelity as a potential motive, while investigations into the horrific crime are ongoing.

Eyewitness accounts described a dramatic descent followed by a massive explosion upon impact. Emergency services evacuated nearby residents, although no injuries were reported on the ground.

title: 'Don't take court for granted': Delhi court summons Nora Fatehi again in extortion case
content:
Delhi court directs Nora Fatehi to appear on Nov 6 in Sukesh Chandrasekhar case

NEW DELHI: Delhi Rouse Avenue court on Monday issued fresh summons to actor Nora Fatehi, directing her to appear on November 6 to record her evidence in the Rs 200-crore extortion case linked to conman Sukesh Chandrasekhar. The development came after Delhi Police informed the court that Fatehi had been summoned but it had no information on whether she would appear. Fatehi's counsel moved an application seeking exemption from her appearance. The court, however, pulled up her counsel, observing that she was a witness and was expected to be present. "She is a witness and was supposed to be here. Her conduct is not up to the mark. Don't take the court for granted," the court said while issuing fresh summons.

End of Article
